answer_1.quote: In this work, we present a novel instruction generation model that can produce a variety of humanlike instructions ... Our Spatially-Aware Speaker (SAS) model generates information-rich instructions ... The generation of instructions is posited as the converse operation to the standard VLN task, where an agent executes a navigation instruction in a house.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance of SAS instruction generation using standard language metrics such as SPICE, CIDEr, ROUGE, METEOR and BLEU-4.
